programs.description: At Dr Parchure's farmhouse party, a power cut leads to an unexpected situation. The curious guests eagerly investigate the mystery, turning a festive evening into a thrilling hunt for truth.
A village head's desire to win the upcoming elections causes him to ignore his mother's wish for a grandson. However, things take a turn when his wife becomes pregnant.

Chaos ensues when two brothers, Dhananjay and Shantanu, force two friends to pose as their wives as their landlady allows only married couples as tenants.
